title: Number statistics
description:
Read numbers until an empty line, then print statistics about them.

```
Number (empty to stop): 4
Number (empty to stop): 8
Number (empty to stop): 15
Number (empty to stop): 16
Number (empty to stop):
Count: 4
Smallest: 4.0
Largest: 16.0
Mean: 10.75
Above the mean: 15.0, 16.0
```

starter.main.py:
numbers = []
while True:
    line = input("Number (empty to stop): ")
    # TODO: stop on an empty line, otherwise add float(line) to the list
    break

hints: `if line == "": break` ends the loop. `min`, `max`, `sum` and `len` all work on a list.
Collect the numbers above the mean as text (`str(n)`) in a list, then `", ".join(texts)` joins them with commas.
